name: Food Truck Builders of Phoenix
old_description: Stainless Steel Fabrication for Food Tucks & Commercial Kitchens
about:
Food Truck Builders of Phoenix operates from Glendale, Arizona, where it designs, fabricates, and sells custom mobile kitchens. The company focuses on food trucks, concession trailers, carts, and kiosks, along with stainless steel fabrication for commercial kitchens. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in public materials.

The shop builds complete food trucks and trailers from the ground up, handling design, permits, blueprints, and custom stainless steel work such as exhaust hoods, cabinets, shelves, and holding tanks. It also sells and installs new and used NSF‑approved cooking equipment, refrigeration, exhaust systems, work tables, and sinks, and offers a rental program for kitchen equipment. Repair services cover commercial refrigeration, cooking gear, exhaust systems, trailers, electrical, plumbing, and AC, with a 24‑hour turnaround and parts stocked for major brands. Fire suppression inspection, installation, and repair are also provided.

Customers include food‑truck entrepreneurs, chefs, and mobile‑food vendors nationwide; the company notes its units operate across the country. It also serves brick‑and‑mortar restaurants needing stainless steel fabrication or equipment. The business caters to both new builds and remodels of existing trucks.

The company differentiates itself by guaranteeing that every truck and trailer passes initial health inspections in any city or state, beating competitors' written quotes by 10%, and offering seller financing at 0% interest for 12 months with half down. Its repair experience informs equipment selection, ensuring compatibility in the tight confines of a mobile kitchen.
